parsed.reason: The reply handles the draft cap correctly (2 cancels drafted, soccer queued next) and is honest that it will continue. However, two problems: 1) The Wednesday appointment IS visible as a private calendar item, and the parent has explicitly asked to cancel it. Hale can see there is a private item at Wed 9:00am — the correct handling is to draft the cancel (or queue it after the cap), not to ask the parent to "tell it what it is." The content is private but the cancel action is still actionable; Hale doesn't need to know what it is to cancel it, just as it cancels other items. Treating the private item as un-cancellable and requiring the parent to explain it is handing the work back. 2) The reply does not end with "YES to confirm" in the standard way — it uses "YES to confirm these two" which is acceptable, but the framing around the Wed item is the real issue. The soccer queuing is handled correctly per the draft cap rules. The private-item refusal is the meaningful failure here — score 2 at most for effectively returning the job to the parent on that item by saying the content isn't Hale's to act on without explanation.
